templates.name: ESPHome climate (MQTT)

notes.text:
ESPHome takes no remote temperature over MQTT out of the box. For a Mitsubishi CN105 climate (its id being hp), add to the YAML of the node:

```yaml
mqtt:
  on_message:
    - topic: {topic_prefix}/calaos/remote_temp
      then:
        - lambda: |-
            auto t = parse_number<float>(x);
            if (t.has_value()) id(hp).set_remote_temperature(*t);
```

For a climate that regulates on a sensor of its own (thermostat platform), make the relayed temperature that sensor; the timeout turns it into NaN, and the thermostat off, when Calaos stops relaying:

```yaml
sensor:
  - platform: mqtt_subscribe
    id: calaos_temp
    topic: {topic_prefix}/calaos/remote_temp
    filters:
      - timeout: 5min
climate:
  - platform: thermostat
    sensor: calaos_temp
```
